name: RelConduit: Candidates + LightGBM Ranker
note: Per task: time-safe candidate generation (the entity's own past targets, recent popularity, co-occurrence and multi-hop walks over the relational graph, plus frozen MiniLM text kNN on rel-stack post-post-related, all from rows strictly before the seed time), pair and entity aggregate features, and a LightGBM lambdarank/binary ranker. Configs were chosen on val only. Each table is seed 0 or the rank average of the seeds, chosen on val by a fixed rule. Test MAP over 3 seeds (5 on two tasks), mean ± std, is in the repro link. Built by Open Conduit.
author: alsiola
